target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, one vCPU, VirtIO input, current desktop ISO
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-xcaliber-current-2026-11-11.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-xcaliber
verified: X-Caliber started and the storm help popup was dismissed.
Left and right thrusters changed the player ship pixels; Space produced a visible projectile.
Escape returned to a working graphical terminal that accepted and executed a command.
System-server, compiler recovery, terminal keyboard/history, and window-demo recovery regressions passed afterward.
scope_note: Current-image QEMU acceptance. It does not close earlier live UTM X-Caliber/Escape observations or Pi hardware behavior.
